params.body:
`go.mod` replaced `../bextrust-control`, which no fresh clone has. It now replaces `../control`, the folder a clone of the bextrust org gives. The README's build paragraph says to clone `bextrust`, `control` and `crm` side by side.

Needs bextrust/bextrust#1 merged first: it makes `book.Decision` the gateway's `rules.Table`, which `internal/crm/book_test.go` already uses on this branch.
params.title: Build against the org layout
